data.title: Alphaddition
data.solution:
alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"

n = int(input())
i = int(input())
sum = 0

seen = set()

for j in range(n):
    letter = input().upper()

    k = alphabet.index(letter)

    if k % 2 == 0:
        sum += i + k
    else:
        sum -= i + k

    seen.add(letter)

    if len(seen) == 26:
        sum /= 2
        seen.clear()

print(sum)
data.statement:
You must find the sum of [[n]] letters. 
Consider the alphabet as [[i]] indexed, meaning {{A}} = [[i]], {{B}} = [[i]] + {{1}}, and so on, all the way to {{Z}} = [[i]] + {{25}}. 

If a number has an even index, <<add>> the index value from [[sum]].
If a number has an odd index, <<subtract>> the index value from [[sum]].

There is also a <<WILDCARD>> factor- every time all the letters of the alphabet have been called, then divide the [[sum]] by two.

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

You must find the sum of n letters.
Consider the alphabet as i indexed, meaning A = i, B = i + 1, and so on, all the way to Z = i + 25.

If a number has an even index, add the index value from sum.
If a number has an odd index, subtract the index value from sum.

There is also a WILDCARD factor- every time all the letters of the alphabet have been called, then divide the sum by two.
Input
Line 1: An integer n.
Line 2: An integer i.
Next n lines: A letter of the alphabet.
Output
Line 1: The value of sum.
Constraints
0 < n ≤ 75
0 ≤ i ≤ 100

The letters may or may not be capitalized.
